scientific_integrity: The proof is provided in full except for the explicitly cited established direction theorem. No claims of external or independent certification.
scientific_limitations: All primes at least five and modulus exactly the square of that prime; relies on the published Rédei–Megyesi direction theorem. Finite tests are corroborative, not exhaustive in the infinite family. Historical equivalent work may exist.
title: All exponential spectra of the cubic graph over prime-square cyclic rings
